meta.title: A-level Mathematics — formulae and tables
meta.note: There is no national A-level booklet. Each board supplies its own, and the three are not the same list: AQA gives out "Formulae for A-level Mathematics", Pearson Edexcel gives "Mathematical Formulae and Statistical Tables", and OCR prints its formulae sheet on pages 2-3 of each question paper. Provision shown here is taken from those documents, recorded with their retrieval date in sources.yaml, and a board's selector hides anything that board does not allow. Items a board does not print are marked "You must know" where the DfE Appendix B requires them to be recalled without being provided. AQA prints no statistical tables in its Mathematics booklet; Edexcel prints binomial, normal, correlation and random-number tables; OCR prints the percentage points of the normal distribution.

provenance.aqa: AQA, Formulae for A-level Mathematics, v1.2 (first issued August 2017)
provenance.edexcel: Pearson Edexcel, Mathematical Formulae and Statistical Tables, Issue 1 (July 2017)
provenance.ocr: OCR A Level Mathematics A (H240) formulae sheet, printed in each question paper

meta.basis: Two documents decide what a reader may use. Each awarding body's exam-room booklet or sheet is the "On your formula sheet" group, retrieved by scripts/fetch_sources.sh and listed in sources.yaml. The DfE's "Mathematics: AS and A level content" (DFE-00706-2014) Appendix B is the "You must know" group: it lists the formulae and identities students must use without their being provided, in these forms or equivalent forms, except where they are the starting point of a proof. The two lists barely overlap, so the boards' booklets give the additional formulae and Appendix B is common to all three. This is why, for example, the sum of an arithmetic series is given but its nth term is not, and why no board prints the quadratic formula. The boards' booklets are not interchangeable: AQA's is one folded sheet with no tables, Edexcel's is a 48-page booklet carrying statistical tables, and OCR's is two pages inside the question paper.

items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>±</mo><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi><mo>∓</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos (A \pm B) = \cos A \cos B \mp \sin A \sin B</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Tangent of a sum or difference
items.latex: \tan (A \pm B) = \frac{\tan A \pm \tan B}{1 \mp \tan A \tan B} \quad \left(A \pm B \ne \left(k + \tfrac{1}{2}\right)\pi\right)
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>±</mo><mi>B</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>±</mo><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>∓</mo><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfrac><mspace width="1em"/><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>±</mo><mi>B</mi><mo mathvariant="normal">≠</mo><mrow><mo fence="true">(</mo><mi>k</mi><mo>+</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow><mi>π</mi><mo fence="true">)</mo></mrow></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan (A \pm B) = \frac{\tan A \pm \tan B}{1 \mp \tan A \tan B} \quad \left(A \pm B \ne \left(k + \tfrac{1}{2}\right)\pi\right)</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Sums and differences of sines and cosines
items.latex: \sin A + \sin B = 2 \sin \frac{A + B}{2} \cos \frac{A - B}{2} \qquad \sin A - \sin B = 2 \cos \frac{A + B}{2} \sin \frac{A - B}{2} \qquad \cos A + \cos B = 2 \cos \frac{A + B}{2} \cos \frac{A - B}{2} \qquad \cos A - \cos B = -2 \sin \frac{A + B}{2} \sin \frac{A - B}{2}
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mspace width="2em"/><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi><mo>=</mo><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin A + \sin B = 2 \sin \frac{A + B}{2} \cos \frac{A - B}{2} \qquad \sin A - \sin B = 2 \cos \frac{A + B}{2} \sin \frac{A - B}{2} \qquad \cos A + \cos B = 2 \cos \frac{A + B}{2} \cos \frac{A - B}{2} \qquad \cos A - \cos B = -2 \sin \frac{A + B}{2} \sin \frac{A - B}{2}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Pythagorean identities
items.latex: \cos^2 A + \sin^2 A = 1 \qquad \sec^2 A = 1 + \tan^2 A \qquad \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = 1 + \cot^2 A
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mspace width="2em"/><msup><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mspace width="2em"/><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>1</mn><mo>+</mo><msup><mrow><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\cos^2 A + \sin^2 A = 1 \qquad \sec^2 A = 1 + \tan^2 A \qquad \operatorname{cosec}^2 A = 1 + \cot^2 A</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Double-angle identities
items.latex: \sin 2A = 2 \sin A \cos A \qquad \cos 2A = \cos^2 A - \sin^2 A \qquad \tan 2A = \frac{2 \tan A}{1 - \tan^2 A}
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><msup><mrow><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mn>2</mn><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi></mrow><mrow><mn>1</mn><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\sin 2A = 2 \sin A \cos A \qquad \cos 2A = \cos^2 A - \sin^2 A \qquad \tan 2A = \frac{2 \tan A}{1 - \tan^2 A}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Sine rule and cosine rule
items.latex: \frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C} \qquad a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc \cos A
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mi>a</mi><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>b</mi><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>B</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>c</mi><mrow><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow></mfrac><mspace width="2em"/><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>−</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>b</mi><mi>c</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>A</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{a}{\sin A} = \frac{b}{\sin B} = \frac{c}{\sin C} \qquad a^2 = b^2 + c^2 - 2bc \cos A</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Area of a triangle
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>C</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A = \tfrac{1}{2} ab \sin C</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Circumference and area of a circle
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>C</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>π</mi><mi>r</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><mi>d</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">C = 2\pi r = \pi d \qquad A = \pi r^2</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Pythagoras' theorem
items.note: In a right-angled triangle, c is the hypotenuse.
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>c</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>a</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>b</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">c^2 = a^2 + b^2</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Area of a trapezium
items.note: a and b are the parallel sides; h is their perpendicular separation.
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>a</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>b</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>h</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A = \tfrac{1}{2} (a + b) h</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Volume of a prism
items.why: A word formula: both sides name quantities in words, so there is nothing symbolic for the parser to relate.
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>V</mi><mo>=</mo><mtext>area of cross-section</mtext><mo>×</mo><mtext>length</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">V = \text{area of cross-section} \times \text{length}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Arc length and sector area
items.note: For an angle θ measured in radians.
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>r</mi><mi>θ</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>θ</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s = r\theta \qquad A = \tfrac{1}{2} r^2 \theta</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Surface area of a sphere
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mn>4</mn><mi>π</mi><msup><mi>r</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A = 4\pi r^2</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Curved surface area of a cone
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>A</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>π</mi><mi>r</mi><mo>×</mo><mtext>slant height</mtext></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">A = \pi r \times \text{slant height}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Derivatives of tan, cosec, sec and cot
items.latex: \tan x \to \sec^2 x \qquad \operatorname{cosec} x \to -\operatorname{cosec} x \cot x \qquad \sec x \to \sec x \tan x \qquad \cot x \to -\operatorname{cosec}^2 x
items.note: AQA prints these as a table of f(x) and f'(x).
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><msup><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan x \to \sec^2 x \qquad \operatorname{cosec} x \to -\operatorname{cosec} x \cot x \qquad \sec x \to \sec x \tan x \qquad \cot x \to -\operatorname{cosec}^2 x</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Derivatives of tan, sec, cot and cosec
items.latex: \tan kx \to k \sec^2 kx \qquad \sec kx \to k \sec kx \tan kx \qquad \cot kx \to -k \operatorname{cosec}^2 kx \qquad \operatorname{cosec} kx \to -k \operatorname{cosec} kx \cot kx
items.note: The board prints these as a table of f(x) and f'(x).
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan kx \to k \sec^2 kx \qquad \sec kx \to k \sec kx \tan kx \qquad \cot kx \to -k \operatorname{cosec}^2 kx \qquad \operatorname{cosec} kx \to -k \operatorname{cosec} kx \cot kx</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Derivatives of tan, sec, cot and cosec
items.latex: \tan kx \to k \sec^2 kx \qquad \sec x \to \sec x \tan x \qquad \cot x \to -\operatorname{cosec}^2 x \qquad \operatorname{cosec} x \to -\operatorname{cosec} x \cot x
items.note: The board prints these as a table of f(x) and f'(x).
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><msup><mrow><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">cosec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\tan kx \to k \sec^2 kx \qquad \sec x \to \sec x \tan x \qquad \cot x \to -\operatorname{cosec}^2 x \qquad \operatorname{cosec} x \to -\operatorname{cosec} x \cot x</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Quotient rule
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mfrac><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mo>→</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mi>g</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>g</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\frac{f(x)}{g(x)} \to \frac{f^{\prime}(x) g(x) - f(x) g^{\prime}(x)}{(g(x))^2}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Quotient rule
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>y</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mi>u</mi><mi>v</mi></mfrac><mo separator="true">,</mo><mspace width="2em"/><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>y</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>v</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>u</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac><mo>−</mo><mi>u</mi><mfrac><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>v</mi></mrow><mrow><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></mfrac></mrow><msup><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">y = \frac{u}{v}, \qquad \frac{dy}{dx} = \frac{v \frac{du}{dx} - u \frac{dv}{dx}}{v^2}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Differentiation from first principles
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>=</mo><msub><mrow><mi>lim</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>h</mi><mo>→</mo><mn>0</mn></mrow></msub><mfrac><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>h</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mi>h</mi></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">f^{\prime}(x) = \lim_{h \to 0} \frac{f(x + h) - f(x)}{h}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Standard derivatives
items.latex: x^n \to n x^{n-1} \qquad \sin kx \to k \cos kx \qquad \cos kx \to -k \sin kx \qquad e^{kx} \to k e^{kx} \qquad \ln x \to \frac{1}{x}
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mi>n</mi></msup><mo>→</mo><mi>n</mi><msup><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mspace width="2em"/><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><mi>cos</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mo>−</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="2em"/><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><mo>→</mo><mi>k</mi><msup><mi>e</mi><mrow><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi></mrow></msup><mspace width="2em"/><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mo>→</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>x</mi></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x^n \to n x^{n-1} \qquad \sin kx \to k \cos kx \qquad \cos kx \to -k \sin kx \qquad e^{kx} \to k e^{kx} \qquad \ln x \to \frac{1}{x}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Sum, product and chain rules
items.latex: f(x) + g(x) \to f^{\prime}(x) + g^{\prime}(x) \qquad f(x) g(x) \to f^{\prime}(x) g(x) + f(x) g^{\prime}(x) \qquad f(g(x)) \to f^{\prime}(g(x)) g^{\prime}(x)

items.name: Integral of a fraction with the derivative on top
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \frac{f^{\prime}(x)}{f(x)}\, dx = \ln |f(x)| + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Integral of a fraction with the derivative on top
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><mfrac><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \frac{f^{\prime}(x)}{f(x)}\, dx = \ln f(x) + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Integral of a function of a function
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><msup><mi>f</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>n</mi></msup><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></mfrac><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>x</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><msup><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msup><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int f^{\prime}(x) (f(x))^n\, dx = \frac{1}{n + 1} (f(x))^{n+1} + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Integral of tan x
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \tan x\, dx = \ln |\sec x| + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \cot x\, dx = \ln |\sin x| + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><msup><mrow><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo></mrow><mn>2</mn></msup><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>k</mi></mfrac><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \sec^2 kx\, dx = \frac{1}{k} \tan kx + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Integral of tan kx
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><mi>tan</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>k</mi></mfrac><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mi>sec</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \tan kx\, dx = \frac{1}{k} \ln |\sec kx| + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Integral of cot kx
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mo>∫</mo><mi>cot</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mi>k</mi></mfrac><mi>ln</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mi>sin</mi><mo>⁡</mo><mi>k</mi><mi>x</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">∣</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>c</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int \cot kx\, dx = \frac{1}{k} \ln |\sin kx| + c</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Area under a curve
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mtext>area under a curve</mtext><mo>=</mo><msubsup><mo>∫</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msubsup><mi>y</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mspace width="1em"/><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>y</mi><mo>≥</mo><mn>0</mn><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\text{area under a curve} = \int_a^b y\, dx \quad (y \ge 0)</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Trapezium rule
items.latex: \int_a^b y\, dx \approx \tfrac{1}{2} h \left\{ (y_0 + y_n) + 2(y_1 + y_2 + \dots + y_{n-1}) \right\}, \quad \text{where } h = \frac{b - a}{n}
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msubsup><mo>∫</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>b</mi></msubsup><mi>y</mi><mtext> </mtext><mi>d</mi><mi>x</mi><mo>≈</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mi>h</mi><mrow><mo fence="true">{</mo><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>0</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>1</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msub><mo>+</mo><mo>⋯</mo><mo>+</mo><msub><mi>y</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>−</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mo fence="true">}</mo></mrow><mo separator="true">,</mo><mspace width="1em"/><mtext>where </mtext><mi>h</mi><mo>=</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>b</mi><mo>−</mo><mi>a</mi></mrow><mi>n</mi></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\int_a^b y\, dx \approx \tfrac{1}{2} h \left\{ (y_0 + y_n) + 2(y_1 + y_2 + \dots + y_{n-1}) \right\}, \quad \text{where } h = \frac{b - a}{n}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Newton-Raphson iteration
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msub><mi>x</mi><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo><mn>1</mn></mrow></msub><mo>=</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo>−</mo><mfrac><mrow><mi>f</mi><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow><mrow><msup><mi>f</mi><mo mathvariant="normal" lspace="0em" rspace="0em">′</mo></msup><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><msub><mi>x</mi><mi>n</mi></msub><mo stretchy="false">)</mo></mrow></mfrac></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">x_{n+1} = x_n - \frac{f(x_n)}{f^{\prime}(x_n)}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Magnitude of a vector
items.why: Paired delimiters around the magnitude of a vector: the parser cannot read them as one relation.
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mrow><mo fence="true">∣</mo><mi>x</mi><mi mathvariant="bold">i</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>y</mi><mi mathvariant="bold">j</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>z</mi><mi mathvariant="bold">k</mi><mo fence="true">∣</mo></mrow><mo>=</mo><msqrt><mrow><msup><mi>x</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>y</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><msup><mi>z</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow></msqrt></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">\left| x\mathbf{i} + y\mathbf{j} + z\mathbf{k} \right| = \sqrt{x^2 + y^2 + z^2}</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Velocity from acceleration
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>v</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>u</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>a</mi><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v = u + at</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Displacement using initial velocity
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>u</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>+</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s = ut + \tfrac{1}{2} a t^2</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Displacement using final velocity
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mi>v</mi><mi>t</mi><mo>−</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mi>a</mi><msup><mi>t</mi><mn>2</mn></msup></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s = vt - \tfrac{1}{2} a t^2</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Displacement from average velocity
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><mi>s</mi><mo>=</mo><mstyle scriptlevel="0" displaystyle="false"><mfrac><mn>1</mn><mn>2</mn></mfrac></mstyle><mo stretchy="false">(</mo><mi>u</mi><mo>+</mo><mi>v</mi><mo stretchy="false">)</mo><mi>t</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">s = \tfrac{1}{2} (u + v) t</annotation></semantics></math>

items.name: Velocity, acceleration and displacement
items.mathml: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><semantics><mrow><msup><mi>v</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>=</mo><msup><mi>u</mi><mn>2</mn></msup><mo>+</mo><mn>2</mn><mi>a</mi><mi>s</mi></mrow><annotation encoding="application/x-tex">v^2 = u^2 + 2as</annotation></semantics></math>
